summary: The candidate is a substantial partial fix: its regression suite passes and it covers the previously reported MiDashengLM/Ernie shared-dispatch bypass plus selected MiMo, Moss, and Inkling paths. Independent adversarial tests still show that TransformersAutoMultimodalProcessor._load_images downloads and decodes a remote image without mm_media_download/mm_media_load observations, and async processor overrides that call process_mm_data directly bypass _call_process_mm_data and emit no mm_processor observation. Concrete repository instances of the latter pattern remain in MossVLImageProcessor and MiniCPMVImageProcessor. Therefore the original request for well-defined standard tokenizer-manager preprocessing metrics is not fully satisfied.

tests.what_was_measured: Original prepared-base behavior against the candidate regression: all four tests failed because the metrics hooks were absent.
Candidate regression and neighboring error/decode/metrics behavior: 39 passed and 15 subtests passed.
Independent contract cases: a real bounded local HTTP image through TransformersAuto produced zero per-item observations, and a direct async override produced zero processor observations; 2 failed.
ROCm device availability and a 4x4 FP32 identity matmul on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X; max absolute error 0.0. This is environment evidence only because the reviewed metrics are host-side.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 and executed the numerical check with max_abs_error 0.0.

remaining_counterexamples: TransformersAutoMultimodalProcessor._load_images calls load_image directly for URL inputs outside observe_media_load; a bounded local HTTP fixture loaded successfully while the recording collector received zero media observations.
MossVLImageProcessor.process_mm_data_async directly calls self.process_mm_data instead of _call_process_mm_data, so its HF processor interval is not observed.
MiniCPMVImageProcessor.process_mm_data_async directly calls self.process_mm_data instead of _call_process_mm_data, so its HF processor interval is not observed.
The design does not enforce processor timing around process_mm_data_async as a whole; any specialized async override that directly invokes its processor path can bypass mm_processor_seconds.
remaining_limitations: No model weights were downloaded and no full model server was started; model-specific end-to-end paths were assessed with bounded synthetic fixtures, focused unit tests, and source-path inventory.
The host architecture is x86_64 with one AMD Instinct MI355X. The issue is host-side observability and required no GPU-specific kernel validation.
No C++, HIP, CUDA, FlyDSL, or other native source changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json reports native=null, and no native rebuild was applicable.
Prometheus multiprocess exposition was covered by the candidate/neighboring unit suite, but a production multiprocess server was not launched.
